responsibility: Declares the public IPA interfaces for GCC’s stack-scrubbing subsystem. This header exposes helper predicates and type/decl utilities used by other callgraph and IPA code to reason about strub-specific calling and inlining constraints, discover watermark parameters, make declarations callable under strub rules, validate user-supplied strub attribute arguments, and compare function types for strub-mode compatibility.
same_name_distinction: This is the public interface header for the strub subsystem: unlike ipa-strub.cc, which performs the IPA analysis and body/callgraph rewriting, it only declares helper queries and utilities other GCC code can call to test strub inlining/callability rules, locate watermark parameters, validate attributes, and compare strub-compatible types.
